title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity - SSH v2
description: The information system protects the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted administrative data using secure protocols (SSHv2).
rationale: Prevents unauthorized interception and tampering of session traffic over intermediate networks.

title: Remote Access - Prohibition of Cleartext Protocols (Telnet)
description: Authorize and monitor remote access connections; prohibit remote management using unencrypted protocols such as Telnet.
rationale: Cleartext transmission of administrative credentials facilitates credential harvesting.

title: Remote Access - Protection of Confidentiality for Web Management
description: Prohibit unencrypted HTTP administrative access to network devices.
rationale: HTTP exposes administrative session cookies and tokens to passive network inspection.

title: Authenticator Management - Password Complexity and Minimum Length
description: Enforce minimum password length of at least 14 characters for administrative authenticators.
rationale: Strong authenticator policies mitigate automated credential-guessing attacks.

title: Device Lock / Session Termination - Inactive Session Timeout
description: Automatically terminate an administrative session after a specified time period of inactivity not exceeding 10 minutes (600s).
rationale: Mitigates session hijacking from unattended administrative workstations.

title: System Use Notification - Mandatory Warning Banner
description: Display to users an approved system use notification message or banner before granting access to the system.
rationale: Provides formal legal notification regarding conditions of authorized access and monitoring.

title: Event Logging - Off-Device Log Forwarding (Syslog)
description: Ensure the system forwards security and audit events to an external centralized logging repository.
rationale: Ensures audit records are preserved even if an adversary gains root access to the device.

title: Time Stamps - NTP Network Time Synchronization
description: Use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records; synchronize internal clocks with an authoritative time source.
rationale: Accurate timestamps are required for incident investigation and sequence reconstruction.

title: Cryptographic Protection - HTTPS for Administrative Access
description: Implement FIPS-validated cryptographic mechanisms (TLS/HTTPS) for web-based system management.
rationale: Enforces transport layer security for administrative operations.

title: Account Management - Centralized AAA Authentication Enforced
description: Enforce identity and account management through a centralized AAA architecture.
rationale: Centralized account management ensures rapid revocation of credentials and unified access policies.

title: Least Functionality - Disable Insecure FTP Daemon
description: Configure the network device to provide only essential capabilities and prohibit insecure file transfer daemons (FTP).
rationale: Cleartext file transfer daemons expose network devices to unauthorized remote access and credential harvesting.

title: Access Enforcement - Disable Unattended AUX Ports
description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources by disabling unmonitored auxiliary ports.
rationale: Auxiliary ports represent an unmonitored pathway into core network infrastructure.

title: Authenticator Protection - Password Hash Encryption Service
description: Protect authenticators from unauthorized disclosure by enabling password hash encryption services on stored configuration data.
rationale: Unencrypted passwords in configuration text allow quick offline account compromise.

title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts - Enforce Account Lockout/Delay
description: Enforce a limit of consecutive invalid logon attempts and automatically lock the account or enforce an exponential delay.
rationale: Defends against distributed dictionary and brute-force password attacks.

title: Denial of Service Protection - Disable IP Source Routing
description: Protect against or limit the effects of denial of service attacks by disabling source-routed packet processing.
rationale: Source routing can be utilized to circumvent firewall state tables and routing policies.

title: Boundary Protection - Disable ICMP and IP Redirects
description: Prevent unauthorized modification of device routing tables by disabling ICMP redirect generation and acceptance.
rationale: ICMP redirects can allow malicious internal nodes to intercept or drop traffic.

title: Denial of Service Protection - Prohibit IP Directed Broadcast
description: Prohibit directed broadcast forwarding on interfaces to mitigate participation in network amplification attacks.
rationale: Directed broadcasts multiply attack packet volume, impacting transit networks.

title: Boundary Protection - Disable Insecure Proxy ARP
description: Disable Proxy ARP to prevent unauthorized intermediate packet forwarding and network structure disclosure.
rationale: Proxy ARP creates security ambiguities and facilitates man-in-the-middle attacks.

title: Anti-Spoofing Filtering - Unicast Reverse Path Forwarding
description: Implement ingress packet filtering to verify source addresses matching reachable routing paths via uRPF.
rationale: Prevents spoofed IP traffic from entering the network perimeter.

title: Content of Audit Records - Detailed Timezone and Microsecond Precision
description: Audit records must contain information that establishes what type of event occurred, when the event occurred, and time with high precision.
rationale: Accurate timestamps are required for incident investigation and timeline reconstruction.

title: Audit Storage Capacity - Buffer Logging Configured
description: Allocate audit record storage capacity and configure local buffers to prevent loss of audit records during transport outages.
rationale: Prevents loss of critical telemetry during network disruptions.

title: Time Synchronization - Cryptographic NTP Authentication
description: Synchronize internal information system clocks using authenticated time sources to ensure non-repudiation.
rationale: Protects against clock manipulation and false audit timelines.

title: Transmission Confidentiality - SNMPv3 Privacy and Encryption
description: Protect the confidentiality of SNMP management communications using AES encryption (authPriv).
rationale: Prevents unauthorized interception of network management traffic.

title: Denial of Service Protection - Control Plane Policing (CoPP)
description: Implement control plane policing to rate-limit and protect route processors from traffic overload.
rationale: Guarantees network processor survival during heavy malicious attacks.

title: Transmission Integrity - Routing Protocol Cryptographic Authentication
description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to verify the authenticity and integrity of dynamic routing protocol sessions.
rationale: Prevents unauthorized route injection and traffic redirection.

title: Audit Generation - AAA Command and Session Accounting
description: Generate audit records containing privileged command executions and terminal session starts/stops.
rationale: Maintains accountability for all actions performed by network administrators.
